ex.s: First of all, become aware of when and why you are regressing. _____39_____ Say, “OK.
ex.t: 首先，意识到你何时以及为什么会回视。____比如说："好吧。

ex.s: The boy is in the hospital and doctors say he'll be OK.
ex.t: 这个男孩在医院里，医生说他没事。

ex.s: "Don’t be late for supper," Uncle Paul cried, "and keep to the track so that you don’t get lost!" "OK! " my dad cried back.
ex.t: “晚饭别迟到了，”保罗叔叔喊道，“沿着小路走，这样你们就不会迷路！”“好的！”我爸爸大声回应。

ex.s: He is most probably checking whether everything is OK.

defs.def: （用以引起注意或引入话题）好了，对了
（用于确保别人赞同或明白）好吗，行不
（用以制止对方争辩或批评）得了，行了，好了
safe and well; in a calm or happy state 安然无恙；平安；快活
all right; acceptable; in an acceptable way 可以；可行；尚可；不错
